dependencyDirection: presentation -> domain use cases and providers
data -> domain contracts and external datasources
core / shared -> reusable from any feature layer

layers.core: Cross-cutting configuration, networking, services, providers, themes, utilities, and reusable widgets under lib/core/.
layers.data: Feature datasources, models, and repository implementations under lib/features/<feature>/data.
layers.domain: Feature entities, repository contracts, and use cases under lib/features/<feature>/domain.
layers.presentation: Feature screens, providers, and feature widgets under lib/features/<feature>/presentation.
layers.shared: Cross-feature enums, models, repository contracts, mixins, typedefs, validators, and widgets under lib/shared/.

principles: Three layers per feature (data, domain, presentation)
No documentation rewrites without auditing reality

core.constants: Spacing, colors, fonts, icons, radius, sizes, strings, asset keys, API endpoint paths, Firestore keys, Hive box names.
core.network: Dio client, network info, interceptors (auth, logger, retry).
core.services: Analytics, auth, cache, connectivity, language, notifications, permission, share, storage, subscription, theme.
core.theme: Light + dark themes, typography, button + card themes, AI theme.
core.widgets: Reusable widget library (top-level files + subfolders: admin, ai, animations, buttons, cards, dialogs, game, indicators, playground, premium, quiz, reader, sliver_appbar).

admin.purpose: Admin console (subjects, chapters, questions, users, subscriptions, analytics).

daily_quiz.purpose: Daily quiz delivery, answering, timing, results.

gamification.purpose: XP, streak, levels, badges, achievements, rewards.

guidebook.purpose: Subjects → chapters → reader with bookmarks & progress.

home.purpose: Aggregated landing (continue learning, daily goal, premium, quick actions).

mock_test.purpose: Configurable timed mock tests with score calculation.

notifications.purpose: Notifications center. Phase 14 delivers the full inbox (data, domain, presentation) so the bell in CustomBottomNavigation has a real destination.

search.purpose: Global search across Lessons, Questions, Topics, Books and AI History with debounced live queries, recent + trending surfaces, category filtering, and a Firestore-ready remote seam. Reachable from the Profile quick-action grid and the Quick Actions bottom sheet.

bookmarks.purpose: Universal cross-feature Bookmarks System. Lets users bookmark Questions, Lessons, AI Responses, and Personal Notes from anywhere in the app via a single BookmarkActionButton, and exposes a global /bookmarks hub with category filters, search-as-you-type, sort (Newest / Oldest / Alphabetical), pull-to-refresh, infinite scroll pagination, and an offline fallback banner. Persists locally with a Firestore-ready remote seam. Reachable from Profile quick actions, the Profile bottom nav, and from any bookmarkable surface.

notes.purpose: Cross-feature Notes System. Lets users create Personal Notes, save Highlights from lessons, and save AI Notes from AI Tutor responses. Exposes a global /notes hub with category tabs, search-as-you-type, sort (Newest / Oldest / Alphabetical / Favorites First / Pinned First), pull-to-refresh, infinite scroll pagination, pinned preview chips, recent preview chips, color palette per note, and pin/favorite/share/edit/delete actions on every note. Persists locally with a Firestore-ready remote seam. Reachable from Profile quick actions and the global quick-actions sheet. Cross-links to the Bookmark system via the universal BookmarkActionButton (notes are themselves bookmarkable).

playground.purpose: Duolingo-inspired world map & level progression. Primary post-onboarding home.

subfolders.presentation/widgets: (animations, boss_gate, buildings, cards, challenge_tile, decorations, level_card, level_reward_dialog, locked_level, map, map_node, nodes, overlays, painters, path, progress_path, rewards, sheets, world_map)

quiz_engine.purpose: Unified Quiz Engine producing interactive quiz experiences for lesson practice, daily challenges, mock tests, and boss gates. Handles question loading, navigation, progress, timer, hints, bookmarks, reports, scoring, and submission.

quiz_results.purpose: Quiz Results feature: surface score, star rating, XP/coin rewards, rank progress, accuracy analysis, time analysis, weak / strong topic breakdown, motivational banner, and retry / review / continue / share actions.

subfolders.presentation/widgets: result_analysis (accuracy_card, time_analysis_card), result_components (motivational_banner, statistics_grid), result_footer (result_footer), result_rank (rank_progress_card), result_rewards (coin_reward_card, xp_reward_card), result_score (score_hero_card, star_reward_card), result_topics (topic_breakdown_tile, weak_topics_card)

weakness_tracker.purpose: Diagnostic analytics to highlight weak topics.

widget_builder.purpose: Visually compose Flutter widgets and preview them live.

subfolders.presentation/canvas: Renders the selected widget; contains previews/ and widget_preview_router.dart
